entries.title: Revelation of John 19:1
segments: And after these things I heard a great sound of a numerous crowd in Heaven, saying, Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and honor and the power of the Lord our God!

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:2
segments: For true and righteous [are] His judgments. For He has judged the great harlot who defiled the earth with her fornication, and He has avenged the blood of His servants out of her hand.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:3
segments: And secondly they said, Hallelujah! And her smoke rose up forever and ever.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:4
segments: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God sitting on the throne, saying, Amen! Hallelujah!

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:5
segments: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all His servants, and the ones fearing Him, the small and great.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:6
segments: And I heard as the sound of a great multitude, and as the sound of many waters, and as the sound of strong thunders, saying, Hallelujah! For the Lord God omnipotent reigns!

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:7
segments: Let us be glad and rejoice and we will give glory to Him. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His wife has prepared herself.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:8
segments: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white. For the fine linen is the righteousness of the saints.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:9
segments: And he said to me, Write, Blessed [are] those who have been called to the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he said to me, These are the true sayings of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:10
segments: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said to me, Stop! I am your fellow servant, and of your brothers who have the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:11
segments: And I saw Heaven opened. And behold, a white horse! And He sitting on him [was] called Faithful and True. And in righteousness He judges and makes war.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:12
segments: And His eyes [were] like a flame of fire, and on His head many crowns. And He had a name written, one that no one knew except Himself.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:13
segments: And He had been clothed [in] a garment dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:14
segments: And the armies in Heaven followed Him on white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:15
segments: And out of His mouth goes a sharp sword, so that with it He should strike the nations. And He will shepherd them with a rod of iron. And He treads the winepress of the wine of the anger and of the wrath of Almighty God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:16
segments: And He has on [His] garment, and on His thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:17
segments: And I saw one angel standing in the sun. And he cried with a great voice, saying to all the birds that fly in mid-heaven, Come and gather together to the supper of the great God,

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:18
segments: so that you may eat the flesh of kings, and [the] flesh of commanders, and [the] flesh of strong ones, and [the] flesh of horses, and those sitting on them, and [the] flesh of all, both free and slave, both small and great.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:19
segments: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth and their armies, being gathered to make war against Him who sat on the horse, and against His army.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:20
segments: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet doing signs before it, (by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast), and those who had worshiped his image. The two were thrown alive into the Lake of Fire burning with brimstone.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:21
segments: And the rest were slain by the sword of Him who sat on the horse, it proceeding out of His mouth. And all the birds were filled from their flesh.
